newsitem.title: USA: US June S&P 500 futures push lower late, end down.
newsitem.headline: US June S&P 500 futures push lower late, end down.

text.p: April 10 - U.S. stock index futures ended lower in edgy trade before Friday's PPI and retail sales data. June S&P strengthened after T-bond futures closed firm, but then faltered at 769.50. Traders said June quickly sold off amid good volume, breaching old support at 763.60, setting off sellstops and posting a session low of 761.50. "It was quite a surprise," one trader said of the late move.
